about.title: About me
description: Graduated from EPITA, a French engineering school in Paris, I dove into Computer Science through my studies.
With a strong interest in web development — particularly design, user experience, and performance — I built my career as a Front-End Engineer and have since grown into a full-stack role.
After graduating in 2017, I moved to the United States and joined Heartflow in the Bay Area — a medical software company that helps doctors diagnose coronary artery disease.
Now based in Austin as a Senior Full-Stack Engineer at Heartflow, I lead frontend modernization efforts while building cloud-integrated microservices on AWS.

events.job: Leading frontend modernization of Heartflow's clinical platforms and building cloud microservices on AWS Lambda/ECS Fargate with infrastructure-as-code via AWS CDK.

Maintained and built features for Heartflow's clinical platforms. Led the migration from jQuery/Knockout to Vue.js, integrated Okta SSO via SAML/OAuth, and built a Node.js/Puppeteer PDF generator for FFRct analysis.
Freelance mission developing Innso's new Nuxt.js knowledge base application with rich search and filtering.
Graduated with a Master's Degree in Computer Science, specializing in Web and Mobile Development.
Internship focused on building a new mobile app from scratch with React Native for tracking live event schedules for poker players attending Winamax Tournaments.
Internship centered around full-stack development, implementing new tools and features for Clubvivre's customer and internal platforms.

skills.title: My skills
description: I enjoy building hand-crafted websites with a personal aesthetic touch, and I've developed a strong eye for translating designs into structured, standards-compliant web applications.

My day-to-day is TypeScript with Vue.js and Nuxt (currently my favorite). Frameworks come and go, so I focus on the fundamentals — Vanilla JS, how the browser actually works, networking, rendering strategies, and state management — which is what consistently makes the difference between a good app and a great one.

I've expanded into full-stack work over the past few years — building Node.js, Express, and FastAPI services, deploying them on AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, CloudFront) with infrastructure-as-code via AWS CDK, and shipping through GitHub Actions.
I'm a strong advocate for testing (Vitest, Cypress, Playwright) and observability (Datadog, Mixpanel), and I stay current with the latest trends across the World Wide Web.
